properties.name: ai_inquiry_specialty
properties.label: Suggested specialty
properties.description: What the physician wrote about their specialty, or 'not stated'. Suggestion only; a person confirms it.

properties.name: ai_inquiry_license_states
properties.label: Suggested license states
properties.description: States the physician says they are licensed in, or 'not stated'.

properties.name: ai_inquiry_certification_statement
properties.label: What they say about QME certification
properties.description: What the message says about certification. Never overwrites the staff-verified status.

options.label: Says they are a certified QME

properties.name: ai_inquiry_intent
properties.label: What they are looking for
properties.description: Intent of the inquiry, separate from certification status.

options.label: Established QME looking at the group

properties.name: ai_inquiry_call_availability
properties.label: Availability for a first call
properties.description: When they can talk. Not evaluation capacity.

properties.name: ai_inquiry_review_status
properties.label: Inquiry review status
properties.description: Set by the workflow's rules, not by the model.

properties.name: ai_inquiry_flags
properties.label: Inquiry review flags
properties.description: Checks that failed or need attention (unsupported value, conflict, out-of-state license).

properties.name: ai_inquiry_ref
properties.label: Inquiry reference
properties.description: Submission reference (contact id : submission time). Used to avoid duplicate work.

assumed_existing_in_your_portal.name: physician_credentials
assumed_existing_in_your_portal.label: Credentials
assumed_existing_in_your_portal.description: The credentials field of the join form. Map to your own property in the workflow's Configuration node.

assumed_existing_in_your_portal.name: expedient_qme_status_verified
assumed_existing_in_your_portal.label: QME status (verified by staff)
assumed_existing_in_your_portal.description: Staff-verified status. Read by the workflow to detect conflicts, never written.
